crossRefs.note: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

people.name: Herod
people.line: A Tetrarch who persecuted the early church.

translations.web: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.
translations.bsb: On the appointed day, Herod donned his royal robes, sat on his throne, and addressed the people.
translations.kjv: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
translations.asv: And upon a set day Herod arrayed himself in royal apparel, and sat on the throne, and made an oration unto them.
